name: hud_ui_message_apply_side_image_swap
description: HudUiMessage::ApplySideImageSwap copies the requested side-image swap into the active side image, applies it to the side widget, and preserves only the visible flag.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session; coverage is functional through native HUD message image-state tests.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja decompilation for 0x412790 validates selecting g_HudUiMgr.messages[messageSlotIndex], copying sideImageSwaps[sideIndex] into sideImages[sideIndex], applying that image through HudUiWidget::SetImageBorrowedAndInvalidate, and masking widget flags with 0x10.
The native HUD message smoke verifies side-index swap copies the stored side image into the active side image, updates the widget image, and masks widget flags to the visible bit.
